result.summary: Both GP slots and R groups 1 (H2) and 2 (H1) passed audit 1. They are kept exactly as they were: a YAML comparison confirms the slots and the first two R groups match the attempt-1 draft. The only failed part was R group 3 (H5), with soundness 1. I deleted it rather than replacing it. Its variant cross_mean(LogFloatShares, 15) is the size field itself (trap 3, |rho| 0.78 with size). The diagnosis it was meant to give is already in the correlation table: |rho| 1.00 with H3 and 0.98 with H5. I also considered a replacement R group on another head and rejected it. H3, H4, H5 and H6 are all nonlinear rewrites of size, which removing or swapping a part cannot fix. The only non-size part, the day_flat_run_max term in H3, fails the gate when scored alone, so there is no score evidence for it, and its axis is already covered by slot a and R groups 1–2. This follows rule §3: a failed R group is deleted. R is now 2 groups with 9 variants. I added a short entry to notebook.md under round 2, saying what changed and why and that round 3 spends no GP slots or R variants on the size axis. The c06_check.py 808 2 check prints ADMISSIBLE with exit code 0.
